title: Ruffle 404 on GitHub Pages: ruffle.js loaded from /ruffle/ instead of /dash/ruffle/ (base-path ignored) — Live Preview/Test Movie broken on deploy
description:
USER REPORT: On the GitHub Pages deployment (https://jhead.github.io/dash/), using Live Preview yields a 404 for https://jhead.github.io/ruffle/ruffle.js. The 404 URL is ROOT-ABSOLUTE (/ruffle/ruffle.js) but the app is served under the /dash/ base, so it should be /dash/ruffle/ruffle.js. This breaks ALL Ruffle-based runtime playback on the deployed site.

HEAD at investigation: 9a2dbfaf75af30368a6ca915bab10d4c64a39b2d

=== ROOT CAUSE (TWO independent defects, both present) ===

(a) LOADER URL IGNORES THE VITE BASE.
packages/player/src/RufflePlayer.tsx:75 defaults the prop `ruffleBaseUrl = "/ruffle"` (root-absolute), and line 137 builds the script URL as `const ruffleUrl = `${ruffleBaseUrl}/ruffle.js`` -> `/ruffle/ruffle.js`. Neither caller overrides it: LivePreviewPanel.tsx:378 (<RufflePlayer>) and ShellOverlays.tsx:92 (<PlayerWindow> -> RufflePlayer) both omit ruffleBaseUrl, so both use the /ruffle default. Under the production Vite base /dash/, a root-absolute /ruffle/ resolves to jhead.github.io/ruffle/ruffle.js (the reported 404), NOT jhead.github.io/dash/ruffle/ruffle.js. The URL never consults import.meta.env.BASE_URL. This is the direct cause of the reported /ruffle/ (not /dash/ruffle/) 404.

(b) RUFFLE BUNDLE IS NOT MATERIALIZED IN THE GH PAGES BUILD.
The ruffle bundle is gitignored: .gitignore:42 `apps/desktop/public/ruffle/` (confirmed via git check-ignore on apps/desktop/public/ruffle/ruffle.js). It exists locally only because dev symlinks/copies it from main. The deploy workflow .github/workflows/pages.yml does `actions/checkout` then `pnpm --filter @flash/desktop run build` (= tsc + `vite build`) with NO step to fetch/copy the ruffle bundle into apps/desktop/public/ruffle/. So apps/desktop/dist/ruffle/ is EMPTY in the uploaded Pages artifact. Even after fixing (a), /dash/ruffle/ruffle.js would still 404 until the bundle is deployed. (Vite copies public/ -> dist/ at the configured base, so a present bundle WOULD land at /dash/ruffle/.)

=== JOB 2: Vite base + deploy ===
- Vite base: apps/desktop/vite.config.ts:13 -> `base: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production" ? "/dash/" : "/"`. Production = /dash/, dev = /.
- Deploy: pages.yml uploads apps/desktop/dist (artifact path :43). No ruffle materialization step -> /dash/ruffle/ assets absent in the deployed build.

=== JOB 3: SCOPE ===
Breaks ALL Ruffle-based runtime playback on the deployed /dash/ site: Live Preview (LivePreviewPanel), Test Movie / publish-and-run (PlayerWindow -> RufflePlayer in ShellOverlays), and any flow embedding the bundled Ruffle via RufflePlayer. All go through the single RufflePlayer.tsx ensureRuffle() loader, so all share the /ruffle default. (E2E specs inject Ruffle directly and are unaffected.)

=== WHY DEV WORKS BUT DEPLOY DOESN'T ===
Dev runs on localhost:1420 with Vite base '/', so root-absolute /ruffle/ resolves correctly and the locally-present bundle serves. Only the /dash/-based GH Pages deploy mis-resolves the root-absolute URL (and lacks the bundle).

=== FIX DIRECTION ===
(a) Build the Ruffle URL base-relative to the Vite base: default ruffleBaseUrl from import.meta.env.BASE_URL (e.g. `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}ruffle` -> '/dash/ruffle' in prod, '/ruffle' in dev) or have callers pass it; ensure no leading-slash root-absolute that ignores the base. Watch BASE_URL's trailing slash when concatenating. (@flash/player is base-agnostic, so the app/caller may be the right place to inject BASE_URL.)
(b) Materialize the ruffle bundle under the deployed base: add a CI step in pages.yml to fetch/copy the gitignored bundle into apps/desktop/public/ruffle/ (or apps/desktop/dist/ruffle/) BEFORE/AFTER vite build so /dash/ruffle/ exists in the Pages artifact. Verify ruffle.js + sibling .wasm/core chunks land at /dash/ruffle/ (ruffle.js uses document.currentScript.src to locate siblings, so they must sit alongside it).
Acceptance: on the deployed /dash/ site, Live Preview + Test Movie load Ruffle (no 404) and play a SWF.

Do NOT modify product code as part of THIS QA pass; this task is the deliverable.
